clock: same-process performance.now milliseconds; performance.timeOrigin and process.uptime also recorded

fixedComparison.attribution: INCONCLUSIVE while undelivered GC/live-object-stage equivalence unknown; no false cause or plateau
fixedComparison.rule: Latest preceding observed GC is major for both, kind/flags match, absolute age difference<=250ms and no saved overlapping GC; otherwise screen fails

memoryInterpretation: V8 physical values are heap capacity measurements, not an exact resident subset of RSS
RSS-minus-physical is not exact native attribution
Do not sum V8 capacities with RSS
Shmem is included in file;arrayBuffers included in external

naturalGC.latestBeforeRule: maximum event end<=sampleBefore by interval time, not callback order
naturalGC.terminalTakeRecords: existing finally path only, same recordGC reconciliation

samples: process.memoryUsage before, v8.getHeapStatistics selected scalars, v8.getHeapSpaceStatistics, process.memoryUsage after; sequential timestamp brackets, not atomic
